relation_rationale: The requested overall cannabis withdrawal severity is reported as the Overall withdrawal score on the 19-item Cannabis Withdrawal Scale (each item rated 0–10 for the previous 24 hours). The randomized comparison is nabiximols versus placebo. The treatment-by-time effect covers daily measurements during the 6-day medication phase (days 1–6), while the repeated-measures model includes days 1–9. All 51 randomized participants were included in the intention-to-treat analysis, with missing questionnaires multiply imputed.

measurement.method: Overall severity of cannabis withdrawal measured by the 19-item Cannabis Withdrawal Scale, with each item rated 0–10 for the previous 24 hours.

target.intended_analysis_population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups
target.intended_effect_measure: Between-group difference in change in overall Cannabis Withdrawal Scale severity over time

reported_analysis_population: All 51 randomized participants (27 nabiximols, 24 placebo); intention-to-treat analysis; missing CWS questionnaires were multiply imputed in 5 datasets.
